name: Orihara Orio
source:
The protagonist's old friend from college. An unidentified man who lives at Amanogawa house and eats his meals with the family. He is a troubling parasite.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20041022050240/http://www.pandahouse.net/pandahouse/zoo/waki.html]official site[/url].]
